visual_review.notes: The matching full official Whirlwind face prints Energy 4 in its upper-left cost, with one Chaos Power. The gallery structured Energy field says 3. Preserve raw 3 and use reviewed effective 4. No linked current erratum changes this cost; this correction alone admits no playable card.

findings: Each-player choices occur during resolution and do not target, including the caster’s own choice. Deflect and when-chosen triggers do not apply.
Acceptable Losses requires each player with gear to pick their own gear; turn order begins with the turn player.
Whirlwind specifies starting with the next player. Each player may return any unit, not just their own, to its owner. Choices see earlier completed returns; declining remains legal.
